about: The fixed grids of /seo and /geo (3.4.12): every check and its weight. The score is computed by report.mjs from the status given to each check, never judged as a whole: the same site gives the same score twice, and two passes compare. ok counts the weight, warn half of it, fail nothing; na (does not apply) leaves the check out of the maximum. A weight of 0 is recorded without counting (a bet, or a measure). Changing a grid changes its id: scores are compared only on the same grid.

checks.label: Each page has its own title, 50 to 60 characters, carrying its main keyword
Each page has its own description, 150 to 160 characters
The language on <html>, the viewport, the favicon
Shared links show a title, a description and an image (Open Graph, X card)
One h1 per page, headings in order
The landmarks: main, nav, header, footer
Every image has its alt text (empty for a decorative one)
robots.txt names the sitemap and closes nothing by mistake
The sitemap lists the real public pages, with a real date only when known
Each page names its canonical address
Short addresses in lowercase words joined by hyphens, no opaque identifier
Each language version names the others (hreflang) and is in the sitemap
Images through next/image, fonts through next/font
Structured data: the site (WebSite) and its owner (Person or Organization) with their profiles
A local business: LocalBusiness with address, hours and area, the same name, address and telephone everywhere, the Google Business Profile linked
Accessibility quick wins: labelled buttons and fields, descriptive link texts, visible focus
The main keywords in the titles, h1 and descriptions of their pages
Each key page covers its topic: the entities and sub-topics its readers expect
Reading ease suited to the audience
No two pages aim at the same keyword
Dated content shows its dates (visible, and in its structured data)
Online: no page kept out of the index by mistake, a missing page answers 404
Online: no localhost nor *.vercel.app in canonical addresses, the *.vercel.app address not doubling the site, permanent moves as 301 or 308
Online: no internal link leads nowhere
Online: every address of the sitemap answers, is canonical and indexable
The main text of the key pages is in their HTML (AI robots almost never run JavaScript)
No firewall turns AI robots away unless chosen (the zone host's setting, the hosting's)
robots.txt says a chosen policy for AI robots, from the current list, with no retired name
llms.txt (a bet: no major AI engine confirms reading it for its answers)
Facts an AI can cite: figures, dates, named sources (hints to re-read, not defects)
Who writes and why they can be trusted: experience, expertise, authority, trust
Paragraphs that stand on their own when quoted alone (hints to re-read)
Questions as headings, answered right away
FAQPage markup on real visible questions (its effect on AI answers is plausible, not demonstrated)
The owner described as an entity (Person or Organization) with its profiles (sameAs)
New pages announced at once (IndexNow), for a site that publishes
The site connected to Bing Webmaster Tools (Bing feeds Copilot)
The guided check: the questions customers ask, put to the AI engines, cited or not
